title: Zillertal Railway Jenbach
name: Zillertal Railway Jenbach
kurzbeschreibung: The historic Zillertalbahn from Jenbach: 760 mm narrow-gauge railway through the Zillertal to Mayrhofen with steam train, Kristallwaggon, and regular-interval service.
beschreibung:
Overview

The traditional Zillertalbahn is one of the most famous and storied narrow-gauge railways in all of Europe. Operating on a gauge of 760 millimetres (the classic "Bosnian gauge"), the railway has linked the railway junction Jenbach in the Inntal (Bezirk Schwaz) with Mayrhofen in the upper Zillertal over a route length of nearly 32 kilometres since 1902. Serving as both the backbone of regional public transport and a cherished piece of cultural heritage, the narrow-gauge line impresses with modern low-floor trains running at half-hourly intervals as well as nostalgic steam train journeys set against the majestic mountain backdrop of the Tuxer and Zillertaler Alpen.

Nostalgic Steam Train & Railway Culture

The opening of the railway line on 31 July 1902 heralded the dawn of modern tourism in the Zillertal. A major crowd puller during the summer months is the lovingly restored nostalgic steam train: hauled by historic steam locomotives dating from the early decades of the 20th century, the trains chug along leisurely at around 35 km/h through the broad valley. Highlights of the steam train include the exclusive Kristallwaggon, adorned with 70,000 sparkling Swarovski crystals, and the open convertible summer coach offering unobstructed views of alpine meadows and cascading waterfalls. Refreshing drinks, Tyrolean Zirbenschnaps, and hearty snacks are served in the cosy buffet car. For railway enthusiasts, the line offers the exclusive "hobby engine driver" experience, allowing guests to take the throttle of an authentic steam locomotive under expert guidance.

Visit & Getting There

Regular scheduled services on the Zillertalbahn operate year-round every 30 minutes between Jenbach and Mayrhofen. The nostalgic steam train runs during the summer season from late May to early October, from Wednesday to Sunday, with one round trip per day. Steam train fares (2025/2026 season): single journey adults approx. €21.00, return ticket approx. €31.00, children (aged 6 to 15) half price; bicycles are carried free of charge. Holders of the regional Zillertal Activcard receive discounts on the steam train supplement. Getting there: travel directly to the railway station in Jenbach – the only railway station in Austria featuring three different track gauges (standard gauge ÖBB, 1,000 mm Achenseebahn, 760 mm Zillertalbahn). Easily accessible by ÖBB Railjet and regional trains; Park & Ride facilities are available directly at the station.

Tips

The regular trains of the Zillertalbahn feature low-floor boarding and are fully accessible for wheelchairs, strollers, and bicycles; on the historic steam train, a specially adapted luggage car with a wheelchair lift is provided. Combine your train journey with a cycling tour along the flat Zillertalradweg and take the train back in comfort.
